faq_heading: Questions B2B SaaS teams ask about an AI SEO agent

faqs.q: What does an AI SEO agent do for a B2B SaaS company?
faqs.a: It picks buyer-intent keywords, writes a post for each, links it to your product and feature pages, publishes on your blog every day and reports what went live on WhatsApp. A person on our team checks the work.

faqs.q: Will the posts be generic AI content?
faqs.a: They should not be. Each post is built from facts you approve: your product, the problem it solves, your buyer and true examples. The agent never invents features, customers or results.

faqs.q: Does it help with ChatGPT and AI search, not just Google?
faqs.a: Yes. Posts open with a direct answer, use clear question headings and FAQs with schema, which makes them easier for AI search tools to quote. This is often called generative engine optimization.

faqs.q: Do we need to give it access to our whole website?
faqs.a: No. It usually needs access to your blog or CMS only. Product pages and the main site stay under your team's control.

faqs.q: How soon can we see whether it works for us?
faqs.a: We aim to show you a first demo within 7 days. After going live, judge it over two to three months on impressions, clicks on buyer keywords, AI-search mentions and demo requests from the blog.
